storage: append-only JSONL week-files under <archive>/cftccot/, one file per REPORT date (gz after 9 days — a report stays plain until superseded)
written_by: server/cftcCot.ts archiveCotWeek (12h poll of the weekly source, eager boot)
source: CFTC Public Reporting Socrata API, dataset 72hh-3qpy (Commitments of Traders, disaggregated futures-only) — keyless JSON with NAMED fields, chosen over the headerless positional f_disagg.txt flat file for query-shape honesty. ~274 contract markets/week; Tuesday as-of data published Friday ~15:30 ET. Field names verified live 2026-07-05 incl. quirks (double-underscore swap fields, dropped _all suffixes)
license: US government work, public domain; attribution 'CFTC Commitments of Traders (disaggregated)'

field_map.report_date — week-level dedup key: one coherent week per file; a DESC fetch straddling two weeks keeps ONLY the newest (vintages never mix)
field_map.market/code/commodity: market+exchange name, CFTC contract market code, commodity name as published
field_map.prod_merc_/swap_/m_money_/other_rept_ lo: the four disaggregated trader categories' positions; missing/empty values are null, never zero

confidence_model: RAW official weekly positioning data. Futures-ONLY report (the combined futures+options variant is a different dataset — do not conflate). Positioning percentile/extreme SIGNALS require trailing history the archive is only beginning to accumulate (accumulation substitutes for purchase) — nothing is claimed until ladder gate 2.
cadence: weekly source (Friday ~15:30 ET publish); 12h poll makes off-days a dedup no-op
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). BUILD ORDER 5 #2; hypothesis (managed-money extremes x commodity ETFs, joins EIA inventory work) stays gate-locked — archive + RAW display only.
